descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT TC-24 ER 5; UAT OAT-04 ER 3 · “Backups are daily only, kept 7 days for disaster recovery, and documented.”. Mixed: stated part — backups daily only, kept 7 days, documented; the retention claim wording; our part — restore not bringing back deleted patients without a re-delete step (Q11) (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Approach · TC-24 Deletions · S25 Backups after a hard delete follow OAT-04 and are documented

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U6 After a patient delete, backups follow OAT-04: daily only, kept 7 days for disaster recovery, and documented. (UAT TC-24; UAT OAT-04; TFA-94699 AC 8) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given The cloud Convex deployments' backup settings (dev / prod; the local stack has none) and the written retention claim

When Review the backup configuration and the documentation

Then Backups are daily only, kept 7 days, documented; the retention claim reads 'Live Hospital patient data is deleted within 36 hours; encrypted backups are kept up to 7 days for disaster recovery.'; restoring does not bring back deleted patients without a re-delete step (Q11)

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT OAT-04 expected result + TFA-94699 AC 8, side-by-side document review

Where it ran: dev; test method CONFIG · Config check; lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S25 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-24.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.
